title: Mechanical access parking garages.
officialText:
Mechanical access parking garages shall provide at least one passenger loading zone in
compliance with Section 1106.7 at vehicle drop-off and vehicle pick-up areas.
SECTION BC 1107
DWELLING UNITS AND SLEEPING UNITS
